claim: Payroll browser proof rejects an internally rehashed export unless its exact bytes reproduce the authoritative pre-release payroll lines.

boundary.source: PR #225 payroll verifier files at bc333a24382a0a1017f7fe6dfe8d5253d4129b6a, confirmed unchanged through integration parent 86acdd5424b7570b3bea8e6d1549ea1203d7c8e0

threat.assumption: A matching download checksum header, persisted checksum, row count and reconciliationOk flag prove that exported payroll content equals the authoritative payroll lines.
threat.attack: Substitute semantically different CSV bytes, recompute their checksum, and keep all IDs, row count, persistence fields and reconciliationOk internally consistent.
threat.impact: A self-consistent but wrong payroll export could be promoted as browser proof.

red.failure: Expected false but received true for a release whose authoritativeCsvChecksum differed from computedChecksum.

repair.browser: Reconstruct the server CSV contract from the authoritative pre-release payroll lines, compare the full downloaded text byte-for-byte, and compare independent SHA-256 values.
repair.classifier: Require authoritativeCsvChecksum to be a valid SHA-256 and equal computedChecksum.
repair.gate: Emit payroll-export-content-reconciliation as missing evidence when the binding is absent or mismatched.
repair.test: Preserve the rehashed-content attack and literal byte-contract/formula-safety regressions.
